title: Profile confidence scoring and progressive rollback for E4M3/E5M2 FP8 enablement
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a profile-level confidence scoring system and an automated progressive rollback mechanism to reduce customer impact during FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) rollouts on Hopper. This ticket bundles: (1) a deterministic scoring metric computed from calibration evals and runtime regression probes, (2) a policy engine that maps score bands to rollout actions (continue, pause, shadow, rollback), and (3) integration with canary pipelines and metrics dashboards. The goal is to avoid blunt on/off activation by making profile activation conditional on measurable confidence and to provide a fast, automated path to revert when drift or instabilities are detected.
acceptance_criteria: Confidence score generated per quant profile and per model snapshot (scores present in telemetry for canary and production)
Policy engine enforces at least three bands: GREEN (auto-enable), YELLOW (shadow-only/slow ramp), RED (halt and auto-rollback), configurable via runtime flags
Canary pipeline wired: new profiles open shadow canary for 48h by default; score below threshold triggers automatic pause and rollback with postmortem stub created
Dashboard tile added to Console showing score history, per-layer contributors, and active rollbacks
End-to-end tests validating that a synthetic calibration regression (introduced in test harness) triggers the RED path and rollback within target SLA (<= 10m detection+action)
plan: Phase 1: Design scoring schema and small proto that runs during calibration (static analysis + golden-eval divergence) and in-runtime probes (inference fingerprint checks). Phase 2: Implement score exporter and storage in telemetry (prometheus + tracing tags) and add a policy microservice with simple rule engine. Phase 3: Integrate with canary orchestration (shadow pools) and console diagnostics. Phase 4: Run internal dark-launch across 3 models, iterate thresholds, and prepare runbook for on-call. Phase 5: Ship and monitor, follow with post-launch QA and calibration-of-thresholds sprint.
telemetry_requirements: Emit the following per-request and per-profile: calibration_divergence_ratio (float), per-layer_shift_l2 (list of floats as comma-separated), token_error_rate_est (float), golden_seed_regression_flag (0/1), score (0-100). Alerts: score_drop > 15 points in 5m OR token_error_rate_est increase > 2x should generate P1 alert. Telemetry retention: 14 days for high-res traces, 90 days aggregated.
rollout_plan: 1) Dark-launch profile scoring in staging for 48h. 2) Shadow canary: route 2% of traffic to FP8-enabled variant with score calculation enabled. 3) Monitor metrics for 72h; if GREEN thresholds met, ramp to 20% over 24h. 4) If YELLOW, continue shadow with targeted sampling and manual review. 5) If RED at any band, policy auto-issues rollback to previous quant profile and opens incident ticket assigned to on-call. Rollback policy includes hysteresis: require 2 sequential 5m evaluation windows failing before auto-rollback. Manual override available in Console with RBAC check.
